title: releasing package sssd version 2.10.1-2ubuntu5.2
commit_message:
releasing package sssd version 2.10.1-2ubuntu5.2

* Fix two memory leaks in sssd-kcm. (LP: #2150664)
  - d/p/lp2150664-KCM-fix-memory-leak.patch: free hanging `secret_val.data`
  - d/p/lp2150664-KCM-another-memory-leak-fixed.patch: ensure tmp_ctx is freed on
    all control paths.
